chapter: Theaters, the Navy and the Singletons' partnership
title: First job at the Rose Bud movie theater
summary: Zutty explains that the Rose Bud was a neighborhood movie house, distinct from the downtown Lyric, where he and Steve Lewis got his first job playing for the pictures. Marge raises the Louis hiring story, which Dance defers.

story.theme_name: First paying gigs: getting started as a young professional
story.community_name: First paid gigs: pay, bands and young beginnings

blocks.x: It puzzles me a little bit, Zutty. This at the Rose Bud guy has you your first professional job theater?
Oh, well now you were talking about the Lyric Theater, is that somewhere else?
No, that's downtown. That is downtown.
Well, where was the Rose Bud?
The Rose Bud was up in my neighborhood. It was just a movie house.
See, so Steve Lewis and I got the job in the Roseland playing for the movies, you know.
The Rose bud. Yes. And oh we stayed there quite a while.
Did you tell the story about how you hired Louis? To work for you in your band? In New Orleans?
Well we haven't got to that yet.
I think we told that because...
